raw: van den Berg R. Shoulder Injury

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar.
90+6' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) will take the corner.
90+5' FC Koln work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+1' Badredine Bouanani (VfB Stuttgart) works the corner short.
90+1' Badredine Bouanani (VfB Stuttgart) picks up a yellow card.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.

90' Badredine Bouanani (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Now Stuttgart have a corner.
88' Stuttgart take a short corner kick.
87' Badredine Bouanani (VfB Stuttgart) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
86' Here's the change. Luca Jaquez leaves the pitch and Ameen Al Dakhil (VfB Stuttgart) comes on as a substitute.
86' That will be all from Bilal El Khannouss who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Nikolas Nartey (VfB Stuttgart).
85' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner, but his header is well saved by the keeper.
85' Lukas Kwasniok decides to make a substitution. Joel Schmied will be replaced by Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln).
84' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
84' Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to FC Koln.

81' 1 - 2 Goal Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart)! Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) was put through by Angelo Stiller and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 1:2.
80' FC Koln can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
79' The ball goes out of play. FC Koln are awarded a corner kick.
79' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for FC Koln.
78' Luca Jaquez (VfB Stuttgart) is booked by the referee.

78' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Alexander Nubel makes a smart save to deny him. FC Koln force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
77' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
76' That's a clear yellow card. Tom Krauss (1. FC Koln) goes into the book.
74' Lukas Kwasniok has decided to make a change. Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) replaces Jan Thielmann.
74' Substitution. Isak Johannesson leaves the pitch and is replaced by Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln).

73' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
73' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) whips in a cross from the corner, but Alexander Nubel is well positioned and punches the ball away.

73' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
71' A substitution has been made. Chris Fuhrich goes off and Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) comes on.
71' Here is a change. Tiago Tomas is going off and Sebastian Hoeness gives the last tactical orders to Badredine Bouanani (VfB Stuttgart).

70' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) fires a brilliant shot from the edge of the box, but the effort rattles the right post! It could have been a superb goal. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
70' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
69' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play and Stuttgart manage to earn a corner.
68' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
68' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) gets on the end of a cross and unleashes an explosive shot at goal from close range, but Marvin Schwabe makes a fine one-handed save to deny him.
67' Joel Schmied (1. FC Koln) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
66' A pass by Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is behind the touchline and Stuttgart will take a throw-in.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Linton Maina leaves the pitch and Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) comes on.
63' Lukas Kwasniok has decided to substitute Ragnar Ache and he is replaced by Said El Mala (1. FC Koln).
61' Ramon Hendriks comes off the pitch to be replaced by Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart).
57' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
53' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.

52' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) does well inside the box to bring down a pass from Angelo Stiller. He gets away a decent shot but it creeps just past the right post. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
52' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

51' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play. Stuttgart win a corner kick.

50' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from long range which went towards the middle of the goal, but Alexander Nubel was ready and made a save.
50' A pass by Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
49' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
47' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) trips an opposition player and Matthias Jollenbeck signals a foul.
45+2' Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
45+2' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) launches a cross from the corner, but Alexander Nubel is alert to thwart the effort.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' The free kick from long range, taken by FC Koln, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
42' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) tries to find Angelo Stiller, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
39' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
38' Neat link-up play between Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) and Ermedin Demirovic, but Marvin Schwabe reads the game well and the move breaks down.
37' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Marvin Schwabe.
33' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) sends a long ball in, but Alexander Nubel comfortably gathers the ball.
29' 1 - 1 Goal! Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) sends the keeper the wrong way and scores into the bottom left corner.
28' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
27' Referee Matthias Jollenbeck makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
27' Marvin Schwabe (1. FC Koln) brings an opponent down and Matthias Jollenbeck interrupts the game.
20' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) sends a long ball forward to Josha Vagnoman, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.

18' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
17' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
17' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner kick, but Marvin Schwabe reads it well and stops the effort.

17' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Marvin Schwabe sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the roof of the net. Stuttgart earn a corner.
16' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
16' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. Stuttgart force their opponents to concede a corner.
14' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) brings his opponent down. Matthias Jollenbeck has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
11' Luca Jaquez (VfB Stuttgart) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.

10' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Stuttgart are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
7' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
5' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

4' 1 - 0 Superb finishing from Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln). Ragnar Ache plays a fantastic through ball and finds Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goal and fire a low shot from close range past the goalkeeper. It's 1:0.
1' The first half has just begun.
